goal: Prevent false eviction of valid BIP68 transactions from the mempool after chain reorganizations
Ensure transactions spending unconfirmed parents are not dropped when a reorg lowers the tip or MTP
agreement: Strong support with all review objections resolved
Verified by reproducing false evictions on unpatched nodes (Bortlesboat, DevaanshPathak, tumutech)
Prior objection on mixed inputs resolved by recalculating at new tip (ismaelsadeeq)
Prior objection on time-based locks and test coverage resolved (instagibbs)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes false eviction of valid relative-lock transactions and descendants after reorgs
Protects mempool consistency whenever a reorganization lowers the chain tip or median time past
